cases.name: etaf-desktop-window-lifecycle-and-state-isolation
cases.purpose: Window operations preserve identity, raise order and immutable public snapshots.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-geometry-limits-maximize-minimize-restore
cases.purpose: Size limits and maximize/minimize/restore preserve a normal rectangle.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-workspace-policy
cases.purpose: Workspace selection and removal preserve window ownership and reject invalid changes.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-mounted-window-and-taskbar
cases.purpose: A mounted window remains in the retained application tree while its body is hidden and returns through taskbar restore.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-native-title-drag-converts-pixels-to-rows
cases.purpose: A native title drag converts text-area pixel motion into one logical desktop row.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-application-registry-and-lifecycle
cases.purpose: An application manifest launches, suspends, restores and closes an isolated instance through public callbacks.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-application-errors-are-isolated
cases.purpose: A failing application becomes an error placeholder while other desktop windows remain usable.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-session-roundtrip-restores-app-state
cases.purpose: A serializable desktop session invokes application restore callbacks and reapplies saved window geometry.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-session-unknown-app-isolated
cases.purpose: A missing application during session restore becomes an error placeholder without aborting the desktop.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-tiling-layout-and-split-resize
cases.purpose: Tiling assigns non-overlapping rectangles and applies an adjustable split ratio.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-layout-floating-and-untile
cases.purpose: Untiling preserves a floating overlay and retile restores it to the tree.

cases.name: etaf-desktop-layout-monocle-and-close-sync
cases.purpose: Monocle fills the canvas and closing a window removes its layout leaf.
